dek: LightingAndSupplies.com is a US wholesale and government supplier of commercial and residential lighting and electrical supplies. One of Nomadic Digital's first clients: I troubleshoot the functionality and performance of its online catalog and the WordPress applications around it.
short: One of Nomadic Digital's first clients, since 2016: troubleshooting the functionality and performance of a lighting and electrical supplier's online catalog and the WordPress applications around it.
